notes.title: Prologue fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Prologue fixes and improvements v0.18


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43034943/4d6695f8f6848c3f9c2ab22b9bedc75740391156.png



 Increased number of items in one stack to 32
 Changed monsters AI not to attack the player through walls
 Now fuel won't decay when there are no items in furnace
 Notifications of picked up items
 Fixed a bug where monsters could spawn on floors, when the player was in underground at night
 Better UI scaling for different resolutions
 Fixed a bug where tooltips could cover items on some resolutions & UI scale combinations
 Fixed a bug where you could duplicate saddled alpacas
 Fixed a bug where you could place biomes in the underground
 Changed couple of objects that farmer goblin likes
 Other improvements

notes.title: UPDATE | Patch 1.1 🧰
notes.content:
Hello Minilanders 👋

It's been 4 days since the release of the game's prologue, we would like to thank you all for your commitment, feedback, and opinion about the game. 🤝

For the last 4 days, we have been busy writing down bugs or things that you think should be improved and right now you can download Patch 1.1!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43034943/ed636bcf6178e5e1dec3bc3c639043db48b9d019.png

Patch 1.1 | Changelog

1️⃣. Subtracting some food after drinking salt water:
Our little oversight - now after drinking salt water, hunger will be increased.

2️⃣. Fixed a bug that caused the same music to play over and over again.
By accident, after finishing the song, instead of a new song, the same one was played again and again. Now we have fixed that. 

3️⃣. Added missing "è" characters in French.
Thanks to the French community for reporting this!

4️⃣. Improved visibility of all texts.

5️⃣. Added option to disable screen shake.

6️⃣. Reduced movement of menu items.

7️⃣. Fixes in the tutorial.

8️⃣. Now on the third day we have a ladder.

9️⃣. Slightly changed biome selection system:
Now instead of choosing a biome every day that we get 8 pieces, you will get 4 pieces of the selected biome and 4 pieces of the biome matched to the world.

Thank you one more time!
Miniland Adventure Team
